search_protocol.selection: Purposeful triangulation of peer-reviewed methods, empirical meta-research, community standards, technical specifications, publisher policies, and official guidance. Inclusion supports only named contract decisions.

generalization_rule: Use cross-domain invariants only for machine-checkable identity, lineage, disclosure, and governance contradictions. Apply modality and exact-domain obligations only through matching adapters and current official-source resolution. Never infer accuracy, completeness, fitness, privacy, or scientific validity from documentation, FAIRness, checksums, repository deposit, or a passing contract.

triggers: official policy or specification version changes
new evidence invalidates a blocker or repair route
new data modality lacks a maintained adapter
a source is corrected retracted or superseded
an exact institutional legal funder repository or community rule is needed
update_policy.time_rule: Use explicit effective dates when an authority supplies them. Observed-current pages without an explicit effective date cannot be backcast to earlier projects.
update_policy.live_resolution_rule: Maintained adapters are not a complete legal, institutional, funder, repository, or disciplinary rulebook. Resolve exact applicable authorities from current official sources and preserve unresolved status when that cannot be done.
